open_decisions.question: TSTGEN00 is a confirmed test tool (configuration-driven test-data generator: routes by CFG-TEST-TYPE 'PORTFOLIO' / 'TRANSACTN' / 'ERROR' / 'VOLUME', BR-124; ends with return code 12 after more than 100 errors, BR-125). Is TSTGEN00 modernised, retired, replaced by a framework/test-data service, or kept as test tooling?

TSTGEN00 is classified test_tool (confirmed): classified as test_tool (confirmed); a human must decide whether it is in modernisation scope. Keep it in the modernisation scope (resolved_no_change) or exclude it (excluded_from_scope)?

Ten elementary level-01 FD/WS items have no permanent Field ID (PORTTRAN WS-EOF-FLAG, TSTGEN00 SEED-RECORD, TSTVAL00 EXPECTED-RECORD/ACTUAL-RECORD/REPORT-RECORD, UTLMNT00 ARCHIVE-RECORD/REPORT-RECORD, UTLVAL00 ERROR-RECORD, FILEHNDL INPUT-RECORD/OUTPUT-RECORD). Should the reverse data agent register Field IDs for record-level elementary items so their Java types can be fixed?

TSTGEN00 declares WS-PORT-STATUS and WS-TRAN-STATUS twice (file-status X(2) at lines 71/72 and data X(1) at lines 98/106) and nests the copied 01 records PORT-RECORD and TRANSACTION-RECORD inside other 01 records (lines 52, 58). Which declaration does each unqualified reference mean, and how should the nested copy layouts be modelled?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is referenced but declared nowhere in TSTGEN00, TSTVAL00, UTLMNT00, UTLMON00 and UTLVAL00 (it may have been expected from ERRHAND or RTNCODE). What is its intended layout and owning copybook?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

Several data names are declared more than once: CK-FILE-STATUS (CKPRST group line 35 and child line 38); ERR-VALIDATION/ERR-PROCESSING/ERR-SECURITY (RETHND level-88 and STD-ERROR-CODES fields); RC-SUCCESS..RC-CRITICAL, TRN-TYPE-BUY/SELL/FEE, ERROR-CODE and ERROR-ROUTINE across COMMON, RETHND and TRNREC. What Java naming convention should disambiguate them (for example record-qualified class members keyed by Field ID)?

If TSTGEN00 is kept: GAP-017 - eight generator paragraphs (2210-GEN-PORT-DATA, 2220-WRITE-PORT-RECORD, 2310-GEN-TRAN-DATA, 2320-WRITE-TRAN-RECORD, 2410-GEN-DATA-ERRORS, 2420-GEN-PROCESS-ERRORS, 2510-GEN-LARGE-PORTFOLIO, 2520-GEN-LARGE-TRANSACTION) are not in the source, so no record is written by the code present; GAP-038 - WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is declared nowhere; GAP-057 - WS-PORT-STATUS and WS-TRAN-STATUS are each declared twice. Can the full TSTGEN00 source be located, or is the tool unfinished?
